title: Artist of the Week: Fabrício Peçanha
content:
Hailing from Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul in Southern Brazil, Fabrício Peçanha has secured himself the accolade of one of Brazil’s biggest DJs. He has come to our attention this week thanks to a remix he’s done of Phoenix’s “Love Like A Sunset”.

Peçanha deals in several forms of underground house music, from tech, deep, acid, vocal, to more funk-driven classics. There’s only one thing wrong with this is that it’s a Tuesday, and we wish it was the weekend so we could overdose on 7 Up and hop around to his sounds.

Conal Dougan
